title: DWV Materials: Solid Core PVC vs Cellular Core PVC
description: Selecting the correct Drain, Waste, and Vent (DWV) piping material is essential for structural durability and code compliance. While solid core PVC and cellular core (foam core) PVC look similar externally, their internal structures differ significantly. Solid core PVC consists of uniform plastic throughout, providing high impact resistance and suitability for both pressure and non-pressure applications depending on rating. Cellular core PVC features a lightweight micro-cellular foam layer sandwiched between solid outer skins, making it easier to cut and lighter to handle for non-pressure DWV lines. Understanding these material characteristics prevents installation failures and misapplications on the job site.

Cellular core PVC features a lightweight micro-cellular foam layer sandwiched between solid outer skins, making it easier to cut and lighter to handle for non-pressure DWV lines. Understanding these material characteristics prevents installation failures and misapplications on the job site.
